authority.license_type: Agency to Provide Personal Care Services in the Home
authority.regulatory_scope: Non-medical personal care / ADL support in the client's home

policy.license_truth: License identity, status, expiration and disciplinary evidence come from HCQC/ALiS only.
policy.operational_truth: Minimum hours, pricing, caregiver continuity, employment model, insurance, service area, languages, availability, payer facts and community partnerships require separate direct evidence.
policy.unknown_rule: Missing operational evidence remains UNKNOWN. It is never inferred from licensure, category, directory presence or absence from a provider website.
policy.facility_link_rule: A relationship between an Independent Living community and a PCA is stored only when the community or agency directly verifies preferred/on-site/required access. Otherwise outside-care compatibility and agency relationship remain UNKNOWN.
policy.negative_signal_rule: Failure to find a service or compliance claim on a website is not evidence that the service or protection is absent. Automated research may promote explicit positive facts, while non-findings remain UNKNOWN.
